facility_roles.quote: We propose the first dedicated muon EDM search employing the frozen-spin technique at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Switzerland

intervals.label: proposed at PSI; precursor phase in preparation
intervals.note: Start is the date of the concept paper. As of September 2024 the first phase was to demonstrate the frozen-spin technique "by 2026" and the ultimate goal was a factor 100 improvement by the early 2030s; no approval, construction or data-taking date was found.

name: muEDM
notes: Included as a proposed experiment: its concept paper (arXiv:2201.06561) names PSI as host (A26). No approval statement was found in the status papers.

physics_goals.quote: We propose the first dedicated muon EDM search employing the frozen-spin technique at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), Switzerland
physics_goals.value: Search for a permanent electric dipole moment of the muon with the frozen-spin technique at PSI to a sensitivity of 6e-23 e cm

summary.plain: A proposed experiment at the Paul Scherrer Institute to search for an electric dipole moment of the muon by storing muons in a solenoid with a radial electric field tuned so that the magnetic spin precession cancels (the frozen-spin technique). Its first phase is a precursor demonstration.
summary.technical: muEDM at PSI: frozen-spin muon EDM search with a target sensitivity of 6e-23 e cm, improving the E821 limit by more than three orders of magnitude; precursor phase with 28 MeV/c muons, then 125 MeV/c muons. R&D on beam injection and positron tracking.
